results.cypher: MATCH (p:ArxivPaper) WHERE toLower(p.title) CONTAINS "fuzzy k-means clustering without cluster centroids" RETURN p.title AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2404.04940"}) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id RETURN p.title AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, p.primary_category AS primary_category, a.name AS shared_author ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25

MATCH (seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2404.04940"})<-[:AUTHORED]-(a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p <> seed WITH p, collect(DISTINCT a.name) AS shared_authors RETURN p.title AS answer_value, p.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.primary_category AS primary_category, shared_authors AS shared_authors ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2607.16421"}) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id RETURN DISTINCT p.arxiv_id AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category, a.name AS shared_author ORDER BY title LIMIT 25
